content.short: Growi Finance is a quantitative digital-asset manager building institutional onchain products.
content.description: Growi Finance runs quantitative strategies as institutional on-chain products, curating vaults on Hyperliquid. Quant managers were among the earlier traditional-finance entrants to on-chain vaults, largely because their strategies were already systematic and needed no discretionary layer to translate.
content.meta: Systematic quant strategies packaged as institutional onchain products on Hyperliquid.
